comment: A theme kept in custom properties and read by color functions (hsl(var(--x)), hsl(var(--x) / 0.6), rgba(var(--rgb), 0.25), rgb(var(--rgb)), color-mix() with a var() operand) in backgrounds, borders, box-shadow, outline and a gradient; switching the <html> element to the dark theme with a class at runtime (the selectors that may match the root are banded again for its new class) changes every color changes every color at runtime.
